correctness.rationale: For homogeneous independent Bernoulli site retention on every tree n>=2, E[I]=p sum_v (1-p)^deg(v); covariance Cov(S,I)=p(1-p)F’(p). Tree leaf-surplus n1=2+sum_{d>=3}(d-2)n_d gives F’(1/3)>0, while all degree>=2 terms make F’(1/2)<0 for n>=3. On [1/3,1/2], exact F’’=-4+2n2(3p-2)+sum_{d>=3}n_d[-2(d-2)+d(1-p)^(d-2)((d+1)p-2)]<0, using sharp global bound for each degree-d factor; direct surplus compensation keeps F’>0 below 1/3 and degree signs give F’<0 above 1/2. Thus unique crossing. n=2 yields 1/2, P_n limit1/3 and star limit1/2. Independently evaluated covariance by all 2^n retained subsets on 47 unlabeled trees n=2..8 and verified exact 4-sign connected K15+2-edge-path cyclic witness. Finite tests do not prove all trees; analytic derivative signs and monotonicity do.
